features.name: Snapjaw
features.target: One creature or object per minion

effects.effect: When the abyssal hyena is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), they can make a melee [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) before dying.
This ability gains an edge against any target not at full [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina).
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Until the end of their next turn, each target gains an edge on their next strike. If any target hasn't used their own Cackletongue maneuver on this turn, they can use it immediately at no cost.
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Archer's Cackletongue
features.target: Self and each ally in the area

effects.effect: Whenever a non-[minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) ally within 5 squares of the abyssal archer is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), the abyssal archer can make a ranged [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike).

The abyssal archer doesn't need line of effect to use their abilities against any creature who isn't at full [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), as long as a size 1 opening exists between the archer and the target.

effects.tier3: 7 fire damage; I < 2 the target is burning (save ends)

effects.effect: A burning creature takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of their turns. A burning object takes 1d6 fire damage at the end of each round.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Two abyssal hyenas claw up from the ground in unoccupied spaces within distance.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: One abyssal hyena target turns into a gnoll marauder, keeping their current [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina). If any target hasn't used their own Cackletongue maneuver on this turn, they can use it immediately at no cost.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Whenever a non-[minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) ally within 5 squares of the abyssal summoner is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), the abyssal summoner moves up to their speed and can make a melee [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike).

effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Up to three targets can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike). If any target hasn't used their own Cackletongue maneuver on this turn, they can use it immediately at no cost.

effects.tier1: 4 psychic damage; I < 0 the target makes a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against a creature of the cackler's choice
effects.tier2: 5 psychic damage; I < 1 the target makes a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against a creature of the cackler's choice
effects.tier3: 7 psychic damage; I < 2 the target uses a signature ability against a creature of the cackler's choice

effects.effect: An ally targeted by this ability ignores the damage and can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike).
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Each enemy target makes an **Intuition test**. If any target hasn't used their own Cackletongue maneuver on this turn, they can use it immediately at no cost.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Whenever a non-[minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) ally within 5 squares of the cackler is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), the cackler moves up to their speed and can make a melee [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike).
An ally targeted by this ability ignores the damage and can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike).

effects.effect: Each target deals an extra 3 damage with their next strike until the start of the carnage's next turn. If any target hasn't used their own Cackletongue maneuver on this turn, they can use it immediately at no cost.

features.name: Carnage's Cackletongue
features.target: Self and each ally in the area

effects.effect: Whenever a non-[minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) ally within 5 squares of the carnage is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), the carnage can move up to their speed, then can either make a melee [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against two creatures or use Shrapnel Whip against one creature.
At the end of each of their turns, the carnage can take 5 damage to end one effect on them that can be ended by a saving throw. This damage can't be reduced in any way.

If the carnage is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) while there are still gnolls on the encounter map, one gnoll on the map is transformed into a gnoll carnage, keeping their current [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina).
The carnage summons four abyssal hyenas into unoccupied spaces within distance.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Each target moves up to their speed and can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike). Any creature damaged by one of these [free strikes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) who has M < 2 is knocked [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone).
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The carnage's eyes and all exposed blood within distance glow bright red. Each target makes a **Presence test**.

features.name: Vengeful Tusker
features.trigger: An enemy within distance deals damage to the tusker.

effects.effect: The tusker demon can move through enemies' spaces at their usual speed. When the tusker enters a creature's space for the first time on a turn, that creature takes 5 damage. The tusker demon can end their turn in a [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) size 1 creature's space, preventing the creature from standing up.
While the tusker demon is [winded](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/winded), they gain an edge on strikes, and any strike made against them gains an edge.
